comparison_id: HOCK Purdue GIS FID 669 vs OSM way 283274991
method: Transform both independent raw polygon outlines to the repository local approximation; compute shapely 2.2 polygon areas, polygon intersection-over-union, symmetric-difference area and directed boundary-vertex-to-opposite-boundary distances. Do not compare vertex indices because vertex sampling density/order differs (58 vs 28 vertices).
gis_source: Purdue University BuildingShapes FeatureServer FID 669; EPSG:4326 query geometry
osm_source: OpenStreetMap way 283274991 from saved local XML; WGS84
interpretation: The two outlines overlap over 96.28% of their union area; symmetric difference is 3.72%. The earlier 16.27 m maximum came from point-to-point vertex comparison, which overstates disagreement when two polygons sample the same curved boundary at different vertices. Boundary-to-segment comparison yields 3.603 m Hausdorff. Local residual mismatch remains, but this independent OSM snapshot broadly corroborates the official Purdue footprint. Purdue remains selected as primary campus source; no vertices were blended.
